title: Amelia | Black mini dress with front zip and flutter sleeves
bodyHtml:
This black mini dress is all about effortless edge—the gold front zip lets you own the neckline, while romantic flutter sleeves and lace trim keep it undeniably feminine. It's the kind of dress that feels like *you*, whether you're heading to a summer drinks gathering or a special evening out. Comfortable, versatile, and honestly hard to find with these kinds of details.

Why you'll love it

  • Front zip in gold—adjust the neckline to suit your mood, modern and undeniably bold
  • Soft flutter sleeves with a playful, romantic feel that moves beautifully
  • Lace trim along the hem for a touch of understated elegance and femininity
  • V-neckline that flatters naturally, no fuss
  • Fluid silhouette that skims your frame without clinging, all-day comfort
  • Perfect for summer drinks, date nights, or those occasions when you want to feel like yourself—just better
  • One-of-a-kind piece that turns heads wherever you wear it
